decision_rights.rule: CLAUDE.md, 'No agent blocked: reversible steps go on your own call' (Dinis, 23 Nov 2026 ~03:00 and ~03:35Z, via maestro.c's session; relayed to me by maestro.d at 04:55Z; I read the rule itself in CLAUDE.md on dev)
decision_rights.role_may_do_alone: reversible steps inside its own area: install pinned tools, make and publish its own key by its own signed commit, write its own files, build and ship its own pages, claim unstarted work, merge its own reviewed branch that passes the gate, choose between options it already recommended; each logged under exceptions in its status.json and next report
decision_rights.still_dinis: one-way doors: pinning a trust key in a router; a change to AWS; money; anything legal; publishing a private person's details; deleting a repository, branch or data; pushing to main; a connector; anything CLAUDE.md reserves for him
decision_rights.effect_on_governance: Most decision rights move down to the role. For holacracy.d: the record, charts, drafts, a round of proposals and ratings are two-way doors and go ahead; creating or changing a role, a grant, a session or a name still waits (my own never-list, and a name or a grant is not mine to change); Dinis ratifies the anchor purpose.
